test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

ORGANZA : LJTAMBZ :: TEMPLATE : ?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba916a408f3568f84437c9f1aea31af04580a322625d603d1d1cfe28d80cf146.png] 

**Code : Odd positions letters of given word ORGANZA are given opposite alphabet and Even position letters of given word are opposite alphabet +1. **

ORGANZA : LJTAMBZ

 
• **Odd position ⇔ opposite alphabet**
 
• **Even Po**sition ⇔ opposite alphabet + 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2163918f816ace86fcc7beb211719d04f9fd4e57b56a42b499cd2161a5ddb4e.png] ​

Similarly,

**Code : Odd positions letters of given word TEMPLATE are given opposite alphabet and Even position letters of given word are opposite alphabet +1.**

TEMPLATE :** GWNLOAGW **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2811b0ee3987263906524061ef8d1c4f39556b8464e31cf437a963557dc12fe7.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is **"GWNLOAGW "**.
